title: Layer 3: China Resilience Indicators
title_zh: 第三层：中国抗打击力指标
desc: Whether China's relative advantage materializes depends on these
desc_zh: 中国相对优势能否兑现，取决于这些

tradeSurplus.threshold: Record high. Sustained >$100B = structural advantage confirmed
tradeSurplus.threshold_zh: 创纪录。持续>$1000亿=结构优势确认
tradeSurplus.note: June 2026: RECORD trade surplus $125.62B — exports +27% YoY (fastest since 2021, monthly record $412.4B), imports +36% (CNBC, Fortune, Jul 13-14). Car exports top 1M/month for first time (Guardian, Jul 14). EU surplus hits record (Bloomberg, Jul 14). Exports to US +13.9% YoY in June. AI boom + tariff rush + Hormuz crisis amplifying China's relative export advantage. Domestic demand weak — GDP miss, NEV retail sales falling. Russia-China trade +25.6% H1. Updated 2026-08-02
tradeSurplus.note_zh: 2026年6月：创纪录贸易顺差$1256.2亿——出口同比+27%（2021年以来最快，月度纪录$4124亿），进口+36%（CNBC、财富，7月13-14日）。汽车出口首次突破月100万辆（卫报，7月14日）。对欧盟顺差创纪录（彭博，7月14日）。对美出口6月同比+13.9%。AI热潮+关税抢跑+霍尔木兹危机放大中国相对出口优势。内需疲弱——GDP不及预期，新能源车零售下滑。中俄贸易上半年+25.6%。更新于 2026-08-02

chinaTradeShare.threshold: WTO: #1 exporter since 2009. Share rising despite tariff headwinds
chinaTradeShare.threshold_zh: WTO：2009年起全球第一出口大国。关税压力下份额仍在上升
chinaTradeShare.note: China's share of global goods exports rose to ~15% in 2025, up from ~14.2% in 2020. Absolute export value ~$3.8T.
chinaTradeShare.note_zh: 中国全球商品出口份额2025年升至约15%，2020年为14.2%。出口绝对值约$3.8万亿。

chinaTradeWeight.threshold: No single '% of global tonnage' stat — disaggregated by commodity
chinaTradeWeight.threshold_zh: 无单一'全球吨位占比'统计——按商品类别分列
chinaTradeWeight.note: Individual commodity shares are each sourced from their respective industry data. No credible single 'total tonnage share' exists.
chinaTradeWeight.note_zh: 各商品类别的份额来自各自行业的统计数据。不存在可信的单一'总吨位占比'数据。

industrialProfits.threshold: Positive = cost pass-through working; Negative = margin squeeze
industrialProfits.threshold_zh: 正数=成本传导能力ok；负数=利润被挤压
industrialProfits.note: H1 2026: +18.7% YoY (NBS, Jul 26) — June alone slowed to +15.1%, slowest pace of 2026 (IndexBox/Reuters, Jul 27). Chipmaking sector profits soar 2,500% in H1 amid AI boom (SCMP, Jul 27); electronics industry +96.9% H1 (People's Daily). $720B AI-linked exports driving economy (Firstpost). EU trade imbalance record; China Shock 2.0 narrative at G7. Hormuz crisis amplifying China's export advantage; weak domestic demand cushions via exports. Updated 2026-08-02
industrialProfits.note_zh: 2026年上半年：同比+18.7%（统计局，7月26日）——6月单月放缓至+15.1%，为2026年最慢增速（IndexBox/路透，7月27日）。芯片制造业利润上半年飙升2500%（南华早报，7月27日）；电子行业+96.9%（人民日报）。$7200亿AI相关出口驱动经济（Firstpost）。欧盟贸易失衡创纪录；G7'中国冲击2.0'叙事。霍尔木兹危机放大中国出口优势；内需疲弱靠出口缓冲。更新于 2026-08-02

fxSettlement.note: Lagging indicator but critical for RMB direction conviction. SAFE data still pending for June. Record trade surplus ($125.62B June) and RMB stability suggest exporter USD hoarding pressure limited. Hormuz crisis → increased oil costs may shift FX dynamics. Updated 2026-08-02
fxSettlement.note_zh: 滞后指标，但对RMB方向判断至关重要。6月外管局数据仍未发布。创纪录贸易顺差（6月$1256.2亿）和人民币稳定表明出口商囤美元压力有限。霍尔木兹危机→油价上涨可能改变结汇动态。更新于 2026-08-02

cfetsIndex.threshold_zh: >104 = 央行可能干预；102-104 = 温和可控
cfetsIndex.note: RMB at 6.7775 (daily, stable). PBOC sees stable RMB amid 2-way fluctuations (China Daily, Jul 15). CFETS index last known: 101.41 (Jun 2). No new CFETS reading found this cycle. RMB resilience continues as record trade surplus ($125.62B June) supports. Updated 2026-08-02
cfetsIndex.note_zh: 人民币汇率6.7775（每日，稳定）。央行称人民币双向波动中保持稳定（中国日报，7月15日）。CFETS指数上次已知：101.41（6月2日）。本周期未找到新CFETS读数。创纪录贸易顺差（6月$1256.2亿）支撑人民币韧性。更新于 2026-08-02

chinaEvExports.value: 1M+ total vehicles (Jun, first time) · NEVs >50% · BYD 34.2% share
chinaEvExports.value_zh: 6月汽车出口破百万（首次）· 新能源占比过半 · 比亚迪份额34.2%
chinaEvExports.threshold: Monitor BYD + SAIC Middle East/SEA shipments
chinaEvExports.threshold_zh: 关注比亚迪+上汽中东/东南亚出货量
chinaEvExports.note: June: China's monthly vehicle exports exceed 1M for first time ever, NEVs claiming over half (CarNewsChina, Jul 10). BYD leads NEV export share 34.2% in June; Tesla 4th at 7.2% (CnEVPost, Jul 10). June NEV wholesale +22% as fuel car demand crumbles (CPCA). BUT domestic car market heads for worst year since 2021 — sales -20% (CNBC, Jul 20), NEV retail sales fall 6th straight month (CnEVPost, Jul 8) — exports the only growth engine. Hormuz shipping disruption and record overall trade surplus context. Updated 2026-08-02
chinaEvExports.note_zh: 6月：中国月度汽车出口首次突破100万辆，新能源车占比过半（CarNewsChina，7月10日）。比亚迪6月新能源出口份额34.2%居首；特斯拉第四占7.2%（CnEVPost，7月10日）。6月新能源批发+22%，燃油车需求崩塌（乘联会）。但国内车市迈向2021年以来最差年份——销量-20%（CNBC，7月20日），新能源零售连续6个月下滑（CnEVPost，7月8日）——出口是唯一增长引擎。霍尔木兹航运中断与创纪录贸易顺差背景。更新于 2026-08-02
